task_summary: Perform speaker diarization on input.mp4 and generate RTTM diarization output, ASS subtitles with speaker-labeled transcripts, and a JSON report.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct functional domains: (1) audio processing with VAD and speaker clustering for diarization, (2) ASR transcription aligned with diarization labels, and (3) output formatting for RTTM/ASS/JSON. Combining diarization and transcription alignment into one skill keeps the core pipeline cohesive, while output formatting is a separate concern.

skills.name: evo-diarization-pipeline
skills.description: End-to-end speaker diarization pipeline: extracts audio from video via ffmpeg, runs Silero VAD for speech activity detection, extracts ECAPA-TDNN speaker embeddings via SpeechBrain, and clusters them using agglomerative clustering with cosine distance. Returns diarization segments with speaker labels.
skills.responsibility: Audio extraction, VAD, speaker embedding extraction, clustering, and producing diarization segment data (start, end, speaker label).
dr_sections: 4.3 Determining the Optimal Number of Speakers

skills.name: evo-transcription-alignment
skills.description: Transcribes audio using OpenAI Whisper with word-level timestamps, then aligns each word to diarized speaker segments using overlap-based (IoU) assignment. Groups contiguous same-speaker words into coherent transcript lines.
skills.responsibility: ASR transcription via Whisper, word-to-speaker alignment using temporal overlap, and grouping words into speaker-attributed transcript segments.
dr_sections: 5. Automatic Speech Recognition using OpenAI Whisper
6. Aligning Whisper Transcriptions with Diarization Labels
9.3 Whisper large-v3 on CPU Memory Management

skills.name: evo-output-formatting
skills.description: Handles all output file generation: writes RTTM files using pyannote.core Annotation, generates ASS subtitle files with proper header/timing/speaker labels, and creates the JSON report with pipeline metadata.
skills.responsibility: Formatting and writing RTTM diarization files, ASS subtitle files with centisecond time conversion and speaker labels, and JSON report generation.
dr_sections: 7. RTTM File Format Specification and Pyannote.core
